title: II-VI–WEF advanced-manufacturing partnership announcement
summary: II-VI announced membership in WEF's Advanced Manufacturing & Production Platform, with CEO Vincent Mattera publicly endorsing the partnership.

data.name: II-VI partnership with the World Economic Forum
data.description: II-VI announced that it had partnered with WEF as a member of the Advanced Manufacturing & Production Platform.
data.outcome: Publicly established a WEF advanced-manufacturing partnership and named the company's CEO as its sponsor.
